Scaling Embeddings Outperforms Scaling Experts in Language Models 扩展 Embedding 胜过扩展 Expert：LongCat-Flash-Lite 的稀疏化新维度 中英对照版

Hong Liu、Jiaqi Zhang、Chao Wang、Xing Hu、Linkun Lyu
Jiaqi Sun, Xurui Yang, Bo Wang, Fengcun Li, Yulei Qian, Lingtong Si,；Yerui Sun, Rumei Li, Peng Pei , Yuchen Xie, Xunliang Cai；Meituan LongCat Team；通讯作者：zhangjiaqi39@meituan.com、peipeng@meituan.com

Abstract摘要

While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become the standard for sparsity scaling in large language models, they increasingly face diminishing returns and system-level bottlenecks. In this work, we explore embedding scaling as a potent, orthogonal dimension for scaling sparsity. Through a comprehensive analysis and experiments, we identify specific regimes where embedding scaling achieves a superior Pareto frontier compared to expert scaling. We systematically characterize the critical architectural factors governing this efficacy—ranging from parameter budgeting to the interplay with model width and depth. Moreover, by integrating tailored system optimizations and speculative decoding, we effectively convert this sparsity into tangible inference speedups. Guided by these insights, we introduce LongCat-Flash-Lite, a 68.5B parameter model with ∼3B activated trained from scratch. Despite allocating over 30B parameters to embeddings, LongCat-Flash-Lite not only surpasses parameter-equivalent MoE baselines but also exhibits exceptional competitiveness against existing models of comparable scale, particularly in agentic and coding domains.

尽管 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架构已成为大模型稀疏扩展的标准做法，它正日益面临收益递减与系统层面的瓶颈。本文探索把 embedding 扩展作为稀疏化的另一条有力且正交的维度。通过系统性的分析与实验，我们找出了 embedding 扩展在 Pareto 前沿上优于 expert 扩展的具体区间。我们系统地刻画了决定这一效果的关键架构因素——从参数预算分配，到其与模型宽度、深度的相互作用。此外，通过配套的系统优化与投机解码，我们把这部分稀疏性切实转化成了推理加速。基于这些发现，我们提出 LongCat-Flash-Lite：一个从零开始训练、总参数 68.5B、激活参数约 3B 的模型。尽管把超过 30B 的参数分给了 embedding，LongCat-Flash-Lite 不仅超过了参数量对齐的 MoE 基线，与同规模现有模型相比也展现出很强的竞争力，在 agent 与编码任务上尤其明显。

Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Flash-Lite

1Introduction引言

The Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture has firmly established itself as the dominant paradigm for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling massive parameter counts while maintaining manageable computational costs Lepikhin et al. (2021). By dynamically routing tokens to a subset of experts, models decouple parameter capacity from computational cost, allowing LLMs to scale to trillons of parameters while keeping modest inference latency. However, as the model size and sparsity level increase, the marginal gain in performance diminishes, eventually approaching an efficiency saturation point (Abnar et al., 2025). Furthermore, the practical expansion of experts is constrained by system-level bottlenecks, particularly the escalating communication overhead and memory bandwidth pressure in distributed training. This necessitates the exploration of alternative, orthogonal dimensions for scaling sparse parameters beyond the Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs).

Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架构已经稳固确立了作为大语言模型（LLM）扩展主流范式的地位，它让模型在保持可控计算开销的同时拥有海量参数（Lepikhin et al., 2021）。通过把 token 动态路由到一部分 expert，模型把参数容量与计算开销解耦，使 LLM 能扩展到万亿级参数而推理延迟仍保持温和。然而，随着模型规模与稀疏程度的提升，性能的边际收益不断减小，最终逼近一个效率饱和点（Abnar et al., 2025）。更进一步，expert 的实际扩张还受到系统层面瓶颈的制约——分布式训练中不断攀升的通信开销与显存带宽压力尤为突出。这就迫使我们去寻找 FFN（Feed-Forward Network）之外、可用于扩展稀疏参数的其他正交维度。

In contrast to MoE, the embedding layer offers an overlooked, inherently sparse dimension with O(1) lookup complexity. This allows for massive parameter expansion without routing overheads—effectively achieving parameter extension without computation explosion. Theoretical foundations for this dimension have been established by scaling laws with vocabulary (Tao et al., 2024), which posit that larger models necessitate proportionally larger vocabularies to maximize computation efficiency. To exploit this potential, diverse strategies have been proposed. One prominent direction is structural expansion, exemplified by Per-Layer Embedding (PLE) (Google DeepMind, 2025; Sadhukhan et al., 2026; bcml-labs, 2025), which allocates independent embedding parameters to each layer to scale capacity. Another key direction is vocabulary expansion via n-grams to densify information per token. This concept traces back to lookup-table language models (Huang et al., 2021) in the RNN era and has recently been advanced in LLMs (Clark et al., 2022; Huang et al., 2025; Pagnoni et al., 2025; Cheng et al., 2026). These approaches collectively highlight the embedding layer as a fertile ground for scaling.

与 MoE 相对，embedding 层提供了一个长期被忽视、本身即稀疏的维度，其查表复杂度为 O(1)。这让参数可以大规模扩张而没有路由开销——实际上做到了「扩参数而不炸计算」。这一维度的理论基础由词表规模的 scaling law 给出（Tao et al., 2024）：更大的模型需要按比例配备更大的词表，才能最大化计算效率。为挖掘这一潜力，已有多种策略被提出。一个显著方向是结构扩展，其代表是 Per-Layer Embedding（PLE）（Google DeepMind, 2025; Sadhukhan et al., 2026; bcml-labs, 2025）——给每一层分配独立的 embedding 参数以扩展容量。另一关键方向是通过 n-gram 扩展词表，以提高每个 token 承载的信息密度。这一想法可追溯到 RNN 时代的查表式语言模型（Huang et al., 2021），近来又在 LLM 中得到推进（Clark et al., 2022; Huang et al., 2025; Pagnoni et al., 2025; Cheng et al., 2026）。这些做法共同说明：embedding 层是一块适合扩展的沃土。

Despite the recent interest in expanding embedding parameters in LLMs, several key challenges remain underexplored. First, the comparative scaling efficiency between expert parameters and embedding parameters is not well understood, leaving the optimal allocation of capacity between these two sparse dimensions ambiguous. Second, the constraints of scaling embeddings are still not systematically characterized: it remains unclear how factors such as the total parameter budget, vocabulary size, initialization schemes, and the trade-offs between model width and depth jointly influence the effectiveness and stability of embedding scaling. Third, while some methods for scaling embeddings have been proposed, it is still unclear which scaling strategy is more effective and efficient under different regimes. Finally, scaling embeddings alters the input/output characteristics of the model during decoding, potentially impacting the overall I/O efficiency, yet its consequences for end-to-end inference performance remain insufficiently analyzed and optimized.

尽管近来对在 LLM 中扩展 embedding 参数已有兴趣，若干关键问题仍缺乏深入探讨。第一，expert 参数与 embedding 参数之间的扩展效率孰优孰劣尚不清楚，这使得两个稀疏维度之间该如何分配容量仍然含糊。第二，扩展 embedding 的约束条件尚未被系统刻画：总参数预算、词表大小、初始化方案，以及模型宽度与深度之间的取舍等因素，如何共同影响 embedding 扩展的有效性与稳定性，仍不清楚。第三，虽然已有若干扩展 embedding 的方法被提出，但在不同区间下哪种扩展策略更有效、更高效，仍无定论。最后，扩展 embedding 会改变模型解码时的输入/输出特征，可能影响整体 I/O 效率，而其对端到端推理性能的影响尚未得到充分分析与优化。

In this technical report, we present a study to address these challenges and establish a robust framework for embedding scaling. Our contributions are as follows:

在本技术报告中，我们给出了一项针对上述问题的研究，并建立起一套稳健的 embedding 扩展框架。我们的贡献如下：

  • Comparison of Embedding Scaling vs. Expert Scaling: Through comprehensive scaling experiments across diverse scenarios, we identify specific regimes where embedding scaling achieves a superior Pareto frontier compared to increasing expert numbers, offering a high-efficiency alternative for model scaling.Embedding 扩展与 Expert 扩展的对比：通过在多种场景下做完整的扩展实验，我们找出了 embedding 扩展在 Pareto 前沿上优于增加 expert 数量的具体区间，为模型扩展提供了一条高效率的替代路线。
  • Impact Analysis of Architectural Factors: We establish the complete set of architectural factors determining embedding scaling efficacy, covering the integration timing, parameter budgeting, hash collisions, hyperparameter settings and initialization of embedding, together with the effects of model width and depth. Besides, we investigate different methods of scaling embedding and find that N-gram Embedding offers the most robust scalability.架构因素的影响分析：我们建立了决定 embedding 扩展效果的完整架构因素集合，涵盖引入时机、参数预算分配、哈希冲突、embedding 的超参设置与初始化，以及模型宽度与深度的影响。此外，我们比较了不同的 embedding 扩展方法，发现 N-gram Embedding 的可扩展性最为稳健。
  • Inference Efficiency and System Optimization: We demonstrate that N-gram Embedding largely reduce I/O bottlenecks in MoE layers, particularly when paired with speculative decoding to maximize hardware utilization. Addressing the concomitant embedding overhead, we propose a specialized N-gram Cache and synchronized kernels, ensuring that the reduction in active parameters translates directly to lower latency and higher throughput.推理效率与系统优化：我们证明 N-gram Embedding 能大幅降低 MoE 层的 I/O 瓶颈，与投机解码配合时更能把硬件利用率吃满。针对随之而来的 embedding 开销，我们提出专用的 N-gram Cache 与同步 kernel，确保激活参数的减少能直接转化为更低的延迟与更高的吞吐。

Based on these findings, we introduce and open-source LongCat-Flash-Lite, a model trained from scratch with 68.5B total parameters and 2.9B∼4.5B activated parameters depending on the context. Our evaluation demonstrates that LongCat-Flash-Lite not only surpasses a parameter-equivalent MoE baseline—validating the superior efficacy of allocating over 30B parameters to embeddings rather than experts—but also exhibits competitive performance against existing models of similar scale, particularly in agentic and coding tasks.

基于这些发现，我们开源了 LongCat-Flash-Lite：一个从零开始训练的模型，总参数 68.5B，按上下文不同激活 2.9B∼4.5B 参数。评测表明，LongCat-Flash-Lite 不仅超过了参数量对齐的 MoE 基线——这验证了把 30B 以上参数分给 embedding 而非 expert 的做法确实更有效——与同规模现有模型相比也具备有竞争力的表现，在 agent 与编码任务上尤为突出。

By setting the hidden size of sub-tables to be inversely proportional to the number of sub-tables, this design ensures that the parameter count of N-gram Embedding remains invariant with respect to N and K.

3Comparative Analysis of Expert and Embedding ScalingExpert 扩展与 Embedding 扩展的对比分析

This section presents our empirical findings regarding the comparison between scaling embeddings and scaling experts.

本节给出我们关于「扩展 embedding 还是扩展 expert」的实证发现。

Experiment Settings实验设置

We integrate N-gram Embedding into the Longcat-Flash architecture (Meituan, 2025) and conduct scaling experiments via from-scratch pre-training across varying activated parameter budgets (280M, 790M, and 1.3B). To rigorously compare scaling strategies, we establish a framework that contrasts scaling via N-gram Embedding against scaling experts. Specifically, for N-gram Embedding scaling, we first train MoE models with varying base sparsity levels ranging from 35% to 98% and incrementally incorporate N-gram Embedding from specific sparsity levels. Crucially, at each sparsity level, the N-gram Embedding model is paired with a parameter-equivalent MoE baseline, which attains the same total parameter count by increasing the number of experts. All models are pre-trained on a corpus of 300B tokens. We evaluate model performance by monitoring training loss and validation loss on two meticulously constructed datasets, covering both Chinese and English.

我们把 N-gram Embedding 集成进 Longcat-Flash 架构（Meituan, 2025），并在不同激活参数预算（280M、790M、1.3B）下通过从零预训练开展扩展实验。为严格比较两种扩展策略，我们建立了一套框架，把通过 N-gram Embedding 扩展与扩展 expert 直接对照。具体来说，对 N-gram Embedding 扩展，我们先训练基座稀疏度从 35% 到 98% 不等的多个 MoE 模型，再从特定稀疏度起逐步加入 N-gram Embedding。关键在于，在每个稀疏度上，N-gram Embedding 模型都配一个参数量对齐的 MoE 基线——后者通过增加 expert 数量达到相同的总参数量。所有模型都在 300B token 的语料上预训练。我们用两个精心构建、覆盖中英文的数据集上的训练损失与验证损失来评估模型表现。

3.1Optimal Timing for N-gram Embedding Integration引入 N-gram Embedding 的最佳时机

A pivotal finding is that the scaling dynamics of N-gram Embedding diverge markedly depending on the sparsity level of the base model. Figure 2 presents three distinct scaling trajectories11 1 We utilize the ratio of total parameters to activated parameters on the x-axis as a proxy for sparsity.: the standard MoE baseline (blue), N-gram Embedding applied to a base model with a low parameter ratio (green), and N-gram Embedding applied to a base model with a high parameter ratio (red).

一个关键发现是：N-gram Embedding 的扩展动态随基座模型的稀疏度不同而差异显著。图 2 给出三条不同的扩展轨迹（原文脚注：我们以总参数与激活参数之比作为稀疏度的代理指标，画在横轴上）：标准 MoE 基线（蓝色）、在参数比偏低的基座模型上加入 N-gram Embedding（绿色），以及在参数比偏高的基座模型上加入 N-gram Embedding（红色）。

The figure illustrates that the MoE scaling curve adheres to a strict log-linear relationship. This implies that in low-ratio regimes, a marginal increase in the number of experts yields a substantial reduction in loss. Conversely, at higher ratios, achieving an equivalent loss reduction necessitates a significantly larger increase in expert parameters. Consequently, when N-gram Embedding is introduced at low parameter ratios, its scaling advantage fails to surpass the gains obtained by simply increasing the number of experts. In contrast, at high sparsity levels, the benefits of N-gram Embedding become significantly more pronounced. This observation leads to the following design principle regarding the incorporation of N-gram Embedding.

图中显示，MoE 的扩展曲线遵循严格的 log-linear 关系。这意味着在低参数比区间，专家数量的小幅增加就能带来可观的损失下降；反之，在参数比较高时，要取得同等幅度的损失下降，就必须大幅增加专家参数。因此，若在低参数比时引入 N-gram Embedding，其扩展优势无法超过单纯增加专家数量的收益。相反，在高稀疏度下，N-gram Embedding 的收益会显著得多。这一观察引出如下关于何时引入 N-gram Embedding 的设计原则。

Summary: N-gram Embedding should be introduced when the number of experts exceeds its “sweet spot”.

Summary：应在专家数量超过其「甜点区」之后再引入 N-gram Embedding。

This result indicates that embedding scaling could be a promising scaling dimension orthogonal to expert scaling.

这一结果表明，embedding 扩展有望成为与 expert 扩展正交的一条扩展维度。

3.2Integration Strategy集成策略

3.2.1Parameter Budgeting for N-gram EmbeddingsN-gram Embedding 的参数预算分配

A closer inspection of Figure 2 reveals a distinct intersection between the blue and red curves: as the parameter ratio increases, the performance advantage of N-gram Embedding gradually diminishes and is eventually surpassed by the MoE baseline. This indicates that when a model allocates an excessive proportion of its parameter budget to N-gram Embedding, its performance becomes inferior to that of parameter-equivalent MoE baselines. This observation aligns with conclusions drawn in the concurrent work Engram (Cheng et al., 2026), which posits that the loss follows a U-shaped scaling curve as a function of the N-gram Embedding proportion. In Figure 2, the intersection point lies slightly above a ratio of 20. At this juncture, N-gram Embedding parameters constitute approximately 50% of the total parameter count (given that the base MoE model maintains a ratio of 12). Consequently, we derive a second principle from this phenomenon:

进一步细看图 2，可以看到蓝线与红线之间有明显交点：随着参数比上升，N-gram Embedding 的性能优势逐步收窄，最终被 MoE 基线反超。这说明当模型把过大比例的参数预算分给 N-gram Embedding 时，其表现会不如参数量对齐的 MoE 基线。这与同期工作 Engram（Cheng et al., 2026）的结论一致——后者指出损失随 N-gram Embedding 占比呈 U 形扩展曲线。在图 2 中，交点略高于参数比 20。此时 N-gram Embedding 参数约占总参数量的 50%（基座 MoE 模型的参数比为 12）。由此我们得到第二条原则：

Summary: Allocate no more than 50% of the total parameter budget to N-gram Embedding.

Summary：分配给 N-gram Embedding 的参数不应超过总参数预算的 50%。

3.2.2Mitigating Hash Collisions via Vocabulary Sizing通过词表规模缓解哈希冲突

In the context of N-gram Embedding, hash collisions force a single embedding vector to superimpose the semantics of multiple distinct n-grams. This collision-induced ambiguity impedes learning efficiency and consequently degrades model performance. We identify that selecting an appropriate vocabulary size is critical to mitigating high collision rates. During training, we observed that N-gram Embedding exhibits anomalously high hash collision rates at specific vocabulary sizes, particularly for 2-gram hashing. To investigate the underlying mechanics, we conduct a dual analysis focusing on: (1) Vocabulary Hit Rate, defined as the proportion of vocabulary entries activated at least once by the pre-training corpus; and (2) Hash Collisions, which quantifies the loss of unique token representation due to modulo-based indexing.

在 N-gram Embedding 中，哈希冲突会迫使单个 embedding 向量叠加多个不同 n-gram 的语义。这种由冲突带来的歧义会拖累学习效率，进而降低模型性能。我们发现，选定合适的词表大小是抑制高冲突率的关键。训练中我们观察到，N-gram Embedding 在特定词表大小下会出现异常高的哈希冲突率，2-gram 哈希尤其明显。为弄清其内在机制，我们做了两方面的分析：(1) 词表命中率，即预训练语料至少激活过一次的词表项占比；(2) 哈希冲突数，衡量因取模索引而丢失的独立 token 表示。

For the hit rate analysis, we use an n-gram vocabulary size set to 30× the base vocabulary (128k). For the collision analysis, we sample a range of vocabulary sizes between 30× and 33× the base vocabulary size, computing n-gram collision counts over 100 training sequences for each configuration. The results are detailed in Figure 3.

在命中率分析中，我们把 n-gram 词表大小设为基础词表（128k）的 30×。在冲突分析中，我们在基础词表大小的 30× 到 33× 之间采样若干词表规模，对每种配置在 100 条训练序列上统计 n-gram 冲突数。结果详见图 3。

Figure 3a illustrates that 2-gram hashing exhibits a gradual increase in hit rate, whereas higher-order n-gram hashing rapidly converges toward a hit rate of 1.0. Independent of the hit rate trends, we observe in Figure 3b that 2-gram hashing collision numbers display a strong, non-linear correlation with vocabulary size. A salient pattern emerges: collision counts spike noticeably when the vocabulary size approaches an integer multiple of the base vocabulary size. This phenomenon persists regardless of whether the n-gram vocabulary size is a prime number. Synthesizing these observations, Figure 3b motivates an additional design principle for configuring N-gram Embedding:

图 3a 显示，2-gram 哈希的命中率是缓慢上升的，而更高阶 n-gram 的命中率则迅速收敛到 1.0。与命中率趋势无关，我们在图 3b 中看到 2-gram 哈希的冲突数随词表大小呈现很强的非线性关系。其中有一个很显眼的规律：当词表大小接近基础词表大小的整数倍时，冲突数会明显激增。无论 n-gram 词表大小是否为素数，这一现象都存在。综合这些观察，图 3b 引出配置 N-gram Embedding 的另一条设计原则：

Summary: The vocabulary size of N-gram Embedding should significantly deviates from integer multiples of the base vocabulary size to prevent Hash collisions.

Summary：N-gram Embedding 的词表大小应明显偏离基础词表大小的整数倍，以避免哈希冲突。

3.2.3Sensitivity Analysis of Hyperparameters超参数敏感性分析

We now examine the sensitivity of model performance to the internal configurations of N-gram Embedding, namely the n-gram order N and the number of sub-tables K.

接下来我们考察模型性能对 N-gram Embedding 内部配置的敏感性，即 n-gram 阶数 N 与子表数量 K。

Regarding the n-gram order N defined in Section 2, increasing N enables N-gram Embedding to capture richer contextual semantics, theoretically yielding embedding vectors with enhanced representational capacity. However, this also creates an extremely sparse distribution over the n-gram vocabulary, as high-order n-grams appear infrequently. This sparsity significantly exacerbates the challenge of learning effective embeddings.

关于第 2 节定义的 n-gram 阶数 N：增大 N 能让 N-gram Embedding 捕获更丰富的上下文语义，理论上可得到表示能力更强的 embedding 向量。但这同时会让 n-gram 词表上的分布变得极端稀疏——高阶 n-gram 出现频率很低。这种稀疏性会显著加剧有效 embedding 的学习难度。

Regarding the number of sub-tables K, this parameter governs the number of distinct hash functions applied to each n-gram, thereby substantially mitigating the probability of hash collisions. Nevertheless, empirical evidence suggests that increasing K beyond a certain threshold yields diminishing returns.

关于子表数量 K：该参数决定了对每个 n-gram 施加多少个不同哈希函数，从而大幅降低哈希冲突概率。不过经验表明，K 增大到某一阈值之后收益就开始递减。

Utilizing the 790M activated-parameter model (corresponding to the initial data point on the red curve in Figure 6a), we conduct ablation studies across various combinations of N and K22 2 For large N, numerical overflow during hash computation can be circumvented by applying the modulus operation prior to exponentiation.. The results are summarized in Figure 4. It is evident that when both N and K are set to their minimal values (N=2 and K=1), the model exhibits notably inferior performance. Conversely, for N≥ 3 and K≥ 2, the performance variance across different configurations becomes relatively small, indicating that the model is robust to hyperparameter selection within this regime. Empirically, we observe that setting N in the range of 3 to 5 consistently yields near-optimal performance.

我们使用 790M 激活参数的模型（对应图 6a 中红线的第一个数据点），在 N 与 K 的多种组合上做消融实验（原文脚注：N 较大时，可先取模再乘幂，以规避哈希计算中的数值溢出）。结果汇总在图 4。可以看到，当 N 与 K 都取最小值（N=2、K=1）时，模型表现明显偏差；反之，当 N≥ 3 且 K≥ 2 时，不同配置之间的性能差异相对很小，说明模型在该区间内对超参选择是稳健的。经验上我们观察到，把 N 取在 3 到 5 之间能稳定取得接近最优的性能。

3.2.4Embedding Amplification for Effective Training用 Embedding 放大实现有效训练

In our preliminary experiments, we observed that suboptimal initialization of the embedding module can severely impede the efficacy of N-gram Embedding, preventing it from realizing its full potential. To validate this hypothesis, we revisited an early vanilla experiment configured as per Figure 2, but without any specific adjustments to the embedding module. After pre-training on 300B tokens, we compute the L2 norms of each module’s output and its corresponding residual branch (identity path) across all layers, plotting the norms and their ratios in Figure 5.

在前期实验中我们观察到，embedding 模块初始化不理想会严重拖累 N-gram Embedding 的效果，使其无法发挥出全部潜力。为验证这一假设，我们回到早期一个按图 2 配置、但对 embedding 模块未做任何专门调整的朴素实验。在 300B token 上预训练后，我们计算了所有层中各模块输出与其对应残差分支（恒等路径）的 L2 范数，并在图 5 中画出范数本身及其比值。

Figure 5 exposes a critical disparity: the L2 norm of the first attention module’s output is an order of magnitude larger (approximately 10×) than that of the corresponding identity branch, which essentially represents the output of the embedding module. This indicates that upon summation, the attention output dominates the residual stream, effectively "drowning out" the embedding signal. Although standard initialization of sub-tables and projection matrices in N-gram Embedding ensures that initial output norms match the baseline, this signal suppression phenomenon exacerbates significantly once training progress, leading to substantial performance degradation in N-gram Embedding models.

图 5 暴露出一个关键失衡：第一个 attention 模块输出的 L2 范数比对应恒等分支大一个数量级（约 10×），而后者实质上就是 embedding 模块的输出。这说明相加之后，attention 的输出主导了残差流，把 embedding 信号「淹没」了。尽管 N-gram Embedding 中子表与投影矩阵的标准初始化能保证初始输出范数与基线一致，但随着训练推进，这种信号压制会显著加剧，导致 N-gram Embedding 模型性能大幅退化。

To mitigate this issue, we explore two strategies:

为缓解这一问题，我们探索了两种策略：

  • Scaling Factor: Introducing a scaling factor (typically √D) to the embedding output to ensure a sufficient contribution to the forward pass.缩放因子：给 embedding 输出乘一个缩放因子（通常取 √D），以保证它对前向传播有足够贡献。
  • Normalization: Applying LayerNorm to the embedding output prior to merging with the residual branch. This similarly amplifies the embedding contribution, as LayerNorm enforces unit variance during the early stages of training.归一化：在与残差分支合并之前，先对 embedding 输出做 LayerNorm。这同样放大了 embedding 的贡献，因为 LayerNorm 会在训练早期把方差拉回单位值。

Both techniques were originally proposed in Takase et al. (2025) with the primary objective of increasing residual branch variance to bound backward gradients and stabilize training. In our context, while we observed no significant impact on training stability, these methods—collectively termed Embedding Amplification—substantially enhance the performance of N-gram Embedding. In our experiments, applying Embedding Amplification yields superior performance compared to the vanilla baseline, with a consistent reduction of 0.02 in both the training loss and the two validation losses.

这两种技术最早由 Takase et al. (2025) 提出，主要目的是增大残差分支的方差以约束反向梯度、稳定训练。在我们这里，虽然没有观察到对训练稳定性的明显影响，但这些方法——我们统称为 Embedding Amplification——大幅提升了 N-gram Embedding 的性能。实验中，采用 Embedding Amplification 的效果优于朴素基线，训练损失与两项验证损失都稳定下降 0.02。

3.3Scaling Properties across Model Width and Depth模型宽度与深度上的扩展特性

3.3.1Enhanced Advantage in Wider Models更宽的模型上优势更明显

This section investigates how the efficacy of N-gram embedding scaling evolves with increasing model width.

本节考察 N-gram embedding 扩展的效果如何随模型宽度变化。

We conduct a series of scaling experiments at two larger activation scales (790M and 1.3B parameters), with model depth held constant (10 shortcut layers) while only the width (hidden size and module dimensions) varies. Figure 6 presents the resulting scaling curves. Our analysis reveals two key trends:

我们在两个更大的激活规模（790M 与 1.3B 参数）上做了一系列扩展实验，模型深度固定（10 个 shortcut 层），只改变宽度（隐层维度与各模块维度）。图 6 给出相应的扩展曲线。我们的分析揭示了两条关键趋势：

  • When incorporated at an appropriate ratio, N-gram Embedding consistently yields a lower loss compared to a parameter-equivalent MoE baseline. This advantage gradually diminishes as the proportion of N-gram Embedding parameters increases, mirroring the behavior observed in Figure 2.在合适的比例下引入时，N-gram Embedding 的损失始终低于参数量对齐的 MoE 基线。随着 N-gram Embedding 参数占比上升，这一优势逐步收窄，与图 2 中观察到的行为一致。
  • Crucially, the intersection point between the N-gram Embedding curve and the MoE curve systematically shifts towards higher total-to-activated parameter ratios as the model width (activation size) increases. Specifically, for a 280M activation size, N-gram Embedding consistently underperforms its MoE counterpart once the ratio exceeds 30. At 790M, N-gram Embedding only underperforms on the English validation set at this ratio, while maintaining an advantage on all other metrics. Notably, at a 1.3B activation size, N-gram Embedding retains a clear advantage even at ratios as high as 50.关键在于，随着模型宽度（激活规模）增大，N-gram Embedding 曲线与 MoE 曲线的交点会系统性地向更高的「总参数/激活参数」比值移动。具体来说，激活规模为 280M 时，参数比一超过 30，N-gram Embedding 就一直不如对应的 MoE；到 790M 时，在该比值下 N-gram Embedding 只在英文验证集上略逊，其他指标仍保持优势；而在 1.3B 激活规模下，即便参数比高到 50，N-gram Embedding 仍保有明显优势。

These findings demonstrate that wider models allow for a significantly expanded window of opportunity to leverage N-gram Embedding effectively. Consequently, Figure 6 leads to the following conclusion: for a fixed number of layers,

这些结果表明，更宽的模型为有效利用 N-gram Embedding 提供了显著更大的窗口期。因此，图 6 引出如下结论：在层数固定时，

Summary: Increasing model width confers a greater advantage to N-gram Embedding.

Summary：增大模型宽度会给 N-gram Embedding 带来更大优势。

3.3.2Diminishing Returns in Deeper Models更深的模型上收益递减

We now investigate the impact of model depth on the efficacy of N-gram Embedding scaling. For pre-normalization architectures, the contribution of N-gram Embedding through the identity connection (residual branch) inherently diminishes as network depth increases, as the signal propagating through skip connections carries less direct information from earlier layers (also shown in Figure 5).

接下来我们考察模型深度对 N-gram Embedding 扩展效果的影响。对 pre-normalization 架构而言，随着网络加深，N-gram Embedding 经由恒等连接（残差分支）的贡献会自然减弱——因为通过跳连传播的信号里，来自浅层的信息越来越少（这一点同样体现在图 5 中）。

To probe this hypothesis, we conducted scaling experiments using deeper architectures, building upon our 1.3B activated parameter configuration. Specifically, we trained models with 20 and 40 layers while meticulously maintaining a consistent relative proportion of N-gram Embedding parameters ( 50% of the total parameters) across all tested depths.

为验证这一假设，我们在 1.3B 激活参数配置的基础上使用更深的架构做扩展实验。具体来说，我们训练了 20 层与 40 层的模型，同时在所有测试深度上都严格保持 N-gram Embedding 参数的相对占比一致（占总参数 50%）。

Figure 7b presents a clear comparison of the performance gap between N-gram Embedding and the MoE baseline across these varying depths. A striking observation emerges: as model depth surpasses 20 layers, the performance advantage of N-gram Embedding over the baseline experiences a pronounced contraction. This trend stands in contrast to the effect of increasing model width, as illustrated in Figure 7a, where the performance gap demonstrably widens.

图 7b 清晰地对比了不同深度下 N-gram Embedding 与 MoE 基线之间的性能差距。一个显著的现象浮现出来：当模型深度超过 20 层后，N-gram Embedding 相对基线的性能优势出现明显收缩。这一趋势与增大模型宽度的效果正好相反——如图 7a 所示，宽度增大时性能差距是明显拉大的。

Summary: Increasing model depth diminishes the relative advantage of N-gram Embedding.

Summary：增大模型深度会削弱 N-gram Embedding 的相对优势。

Note that the majority of current practical language models typically operate below 40 shortcut layers (equivalent to 80 conventional layers). Given our finding that increased width consistently amplifies N-gram Embedding’s advantage, and its robust performance even at 40 layers, scaling n-gram embeddings up within these common architectural depths is likely to yield even greater performance gains.

需要注意，目前大多数实用语言模型的层数都在 40 个 shortcut 层（相当于 80 个常规层）以下。既然我们发现增大宽度能持续放大 N-gram Embedding 的优势、而且它在 40 层时表现依然稳健，那么在这些常见架构深度内放大 n-gram embedding，很可能带来更大的性能收益。

4Efficient Inference高效推理

4.1Reduction of MoE Activation Parameters减少 MoE 的激活参数

The N-gram Embedding mechanism effectively redistributes parameters from the MoE layers to the embedding space. This architectural transformation maintains the total model parameters while reducing the number of activated parameters within MoE layers—particularly advantageous in memory I/O-bound decoding scenarios with large token counts. Moreover, the increased size of the embedding layer does not penalize latency, as the computational cost of embedding lookups scales with the number of input tokens rather than the total number of embedding parameters.

N-gram Embedding 机制把参数从 MoE 层有效地重新分配到 embedding 空间。这一架构改造在保持模型总参数不变的同时，减少了 MoE 层内被激活的参数数量——在 token 数量大、受显存 I/O 制约的解码场景中尤其有利。此外，embedding 层变大并不会拖累延迟，因为 embedding 查表的计算量随输入 token 数增长，而与 embedding 参数总量无关。

To fully capitalize on the efficiency gains from reduced active parameters, it is crucial to maximize hardware utilization through a large batch size (as shown in Figure 8a). This requirement creates a natural synergy with speculative decoding. Multi-step speculative decoding effectively expands the “effective batch size”, thereby converting the theoretical advantage of parameter sparsity into tangible inference speedups.

要充分吃到激活参数减少带来的效率收益，关键是用大 batch size 把硬件利用率拉满（如图 8a 所示）。这一需求与投机解码天然契合。多步投机解码会有效放大「等效 batch size」，从而把参数稀疏带来的理论优势转成实实在在的推理加速。

4.2Optimized Embedding Lookup优化 Embedding 查表

Although reallocating parameters from experts to N-gram Embedding effectively reduces memory I/O for MoE layers, it introduces additional overhead in terms of I/O, computation, and communication compared to a standard embedding layer. Minimizing the latency and resource consumption of N-gram Embedding is therefore critical for overall system efficiency. Furthermore, the dynamic and complex scheduling mechanisms inherent in modern inference frameworks make it difficult to pre-determine the exact token sequences for the forward pass, which complicates the optimization of N-gram embedding lookups.

虽然把参数从 expert 挪到 N-gram Embedding 确实降低了 MoE 层的显存 I/O，但相比标准 embedding 层，它在 I/O、计算与通信上都引入了额外开销。因此，把 N-gram Embedding 的延迟与资源消耗压到最低，对整体系统效率至关重要。更进一步，现代推理框架固有的调度机制既动态又复杂，很难预先确定前向传播要用的确切 token 序列，这也让 n-gram embedding 查表的优化变得更难。

To address these challenges, we introduce the N-gram Cache, a specialized caching mechanism inspired by the design principles of the KV cache. We implement custom CUDA kernels to manage N-gram IDs directly on the device, facilitating low-overhead synchronization with the intricate scheduling logic of various inference optimization techniques. This design significantly enhances the computational efficiency of N-gram embeddings.

为应对这些挑战，我们提出 N-gram Cache——一种受 KV cache 设计思路启发而做的专用缓存机制。我们用自研 CUDA kernel 在 device 上直接管理 n-gram ID，从而与各类推理优化技术复杂的调度逻辑做到低开销同步。这一设计显著提升了 N-gram embedding 的计算效率。

In speculative decoding scenarios, where the draft model typically operates with fewer layers and substantially lower latency, the overhead of N-gram Embedding becomes relatively more pronounced. To mitigate this, we propose two complementary optimization strategies: (1) employing a conventional embedding layer for the draft model to bypass the more computationally expensive n-gram lookup; and (2) caching n-gram embeddings during the drafting phase to eliminate redundant computations during the subsequent verification step. These optimizations collectively reduce latency and improve throughput in speculative inference settings.

在投机解码场景中，草稿模型的层数通常更少、延迟也低得多，N-gram Embedding 的开销因而相对更突出。为缓解这一点，我们提出两项互补的优化策略：(1) 草稿模型改用常规 embedding 层，绕过计算代价更高的 n-gram 查表；(2) 在草稿阶段缓存 n-gram embedding，以消除后续验证步骤中的重复计算。这些优化共同降低了投机推理下的延迟、提升了吞吐。

4.3Rethinking N-gram Embedding Optimization: The Role of Speculative Decoding重新思考 N-gram Embedding 优化：投机解码的作用

Beyond hardware efficiency, we posit that the N-gram Embedding structure inherently encodes rich local context and token co-occurrence information, offering unexplored synergies with speculative decoding. We identify two promising directions where the semantic richness of N-gram Embedding could potentially be leveraged to further accelerate inference.

除硬件效率之外，我们认为 N-gram Embedding 的结构本身就编码了丰富的局部上下文与 token 共现信息，与投机解码之间存在尚未被挖掘的协同空间。我们指出两个有前景的方向，有望借 N-gram Embedding 的语义丰富性进一步加速推理。

N-gram Embedding based drafting: Since the N-gram Embedding aggregates information from the preceding N-1 tokens, it implicitly captures short-range dependencies. We are currently exploring architectures to repurpose the N-gram embedding as an ultra-fast draft model. While a primary candidate involves attaching a lightweight linear projection directly to the N-gram Embedding outputs, we are investigating a broader design space to fully exploit the captured local context for efficient token prediction.

基于 N-gram Embedding 的草稿生成：由于 N-gram Embedding 聚合了前 N-1 个 token 的信息，它隐式地捕获了短程依赖。我们正在探索把 n-gram embedding 改造成超快草稿模型的架构。一个主要候选方案是在 N-gram Embedding 输出上直接接一个轻量线性投影，但我们同时在考察更大的设计空间，以充分利用其所捕获的局部上下文来做高效 token 预测。

Early rejection: The N-gram Embedding representation could also serve as a semantic consistency check (or confidence estimator) for tokens generated by external draft models. Draft tokens that result in low-probability match under N-gram Embedding might be "early-rejected" before entering the expensive verification phase of the target model. Theoretically, this pruning strategy would reduce the workload of the verification step, offering a pathway to further optimize end-to-end latency.

提前拒绝：N-gram Embedding 表示还可以充当对外部草稿模型所生成 token 的语义一致性检查（或置信度估计器）。在 N-gram Embedding 下匹配概率偏低的草稿 token，可以在进入目标模型代价高昂的验证阶段之前就被「提前拒绝」。理论上，这种剪枝策略能减轻验证步骤的工作量，为进一步优化端到端延迟提供了一条路径。

5Integration with Per-Layer Embedding与 Per-Layer Embedding 的结合

As mentioned in Section 1, Per-Layer Embedding (PLE) is another way to scale parameters by allocating embedding parameters across layers. This section provides a direct comparison between N-gram Embedding and PLE, and introduces an attempt to integrate both approaches.

如第 1 节所述，Per-Layer Embedding（PLE）是通过把 embedding 参数分配到各层来扩展参数的另一条路。本节直接对比 N-gram Embedding 与 PLE，并尝试把两者结合起来。

5.1Per-Layer EmbeddingPer-Layer Embedding

PLE is applied in Google DeepMind (2024) and further studied in Sadhukhan et al. (2026). PLE directly substitutes the output of up-projection matrix in the SwiGLU module with the embedding output, which is the most efficient method for injecting embedding information in our experiments. Let x(l)i be the i-th input vector of the FFN module in layer l, the FFN output with PLE can be formalized as follows

PLE 在 Google DeepMind (2024) 中被采用，并在 Sadhukhan et al. (2026) 中得到进一步研究。PLE 直接用 embedding 输出替换 SwiGLU 模块中 up-projection 矩阵的输出，在我们的实验里这是注入 embedding 信息最高效的做法。设 x(l)i 为第 l 层 FFN 模块的第 i 个输入向量，带 PLE 的 FFN 输出可形式化为

where Wd(l) and W(l)g denote the down-projection and gate-projection matrices of layer l respectively, and E0(l) is the embedding table of layer l, with identical shape to the base embedding table in Eq. 1.

其中 Wd(l) 与 W(l)g 分别是第 l 层的 down-projection 与 gate-projection 矩阵，E0(l) 是第 l 层的 embedding 表，形状与式 1 中的基座 embedding 表相同。

5.2Per-Layer N-gram EmbeddingPer-Layer N-gram Embedding

Building upon PLE, we propose Per-Layer N-gram Embedding (PLNE), a novel extension that replaces the base embedding outputs with N-gram Embedding outputs at each layer, thereby enabling more flexible and targeted parameter scaling within the MoE framework. PLNE can be written as

在 PLE 的基础上，我们提出 Per-Layer N-gram Embedding（PLNE）：这是一种新的扩展，在每一层用 N-gram Embedding 输出替换基座 embedding 输出，从而在 MoE 框架内实现更灵活、更有针对性的参数扩展。PLNE 可写为

where e(l)i is computed according to Eq. 3, with layer-specific embedding table and projection matrix.

5.3Empirical Comparison实证对比

For both PLE and PLNE, embedding information is injected exclusively into the MLP within the dense sub-layer of each shortcut layer. Since each PLNE layer incorporates an n-gram vocabulary in addition to the base vocabulary, it introduces a larger number of parameters per layer compared to PLE. To avoid confounding factors related to layer positioning, we do not directly compare between PLE and PLNE under equivalent total parameter counts. Instead, we evaluate PLE and PLNE against their respective parameter-equivalent N-gram Embedding (NE) baselines, as illustrated in Figure 9.

对 PLE 与 PLNE 而言，embedding 信息都只注入到每个 shortcut 层中 dense 子层的 MLP 里。由于每个 PLNE 层在基座词表之外还带有一份 n-gram 词表，它每层引入的参数比 PLE 更多。为避免层位置带来的混杂因素，我们不在总参数量对等的条件下直接比较 PLE 与 PLNE，而是分别把 PLE、PLNE 与各自参数量对齐的 N-gram Embedding（NE）基线对比，如图 9 所示。

Figure 9 reveals that PLE underperforms relative to N-gram Embedding, whereas PLNE yields marginal improvements over NE. We attribute the former to the superior learning efficiency of N-gram Embedding compared to standard embeddings. Consequently, we focused our scaling analysis on PLNE. However, in subsequent experiments involving increased model width or depth, PLNE failed to exhibit a consistent advantage, performing on par with NE in most scenarios. Given that PLNE inherently increases activated parameters (due to the addition of a substantial projection matrix in each layer), we opted not to adopt PLNE for our larger-scale experiments. Nonetheless, this approach merits further investigation—specifically regarding the optimal allocation of embedding parameters across layers, such as determining whether to concentrate them in a few specific layers or distribute them uniformly throughout the network.

图 9 显示，PLE 的表现不如 N-gram Embedding，而 PLNE 相对 NE 只有边际提升。我们把前者的原因归结为 N-gram Embedding 的学习效率优于标准 embedding。因此我们把扩展分析集中在 PLNE 上。然而在后续涉及增大模型宽度或深度的实验中，PLNE 并未表现出一致优势，在多数场景下与 NE 持平。考虑到 PLNE 本身会增加激活参数（每层都多出一个规模可观的投影矩阵），我们在更大规模的实验中未采用 PLNE。不过这条路线仍值得进一步研究——特别是 embedding 参数在各层之间如何最优分配，例如是集中放在少数几层，还是均匀铺满整个网络。

6LongCat-Flash-LiteLongCat-Flash-Lite

Leveraging the insights from our previous analysis, we introduce LongCat-Flash-Lite, a model trained from scratch with integrated N-gram Embedding. LongCat-Flash-Lite undergoes a complete pipeline of pre-training, mid-training, and supervised finetuning, and demonstrates highly competitive performance for its scale.

基于前述分析的洞见，我们提出 LongCat-Flash-Lite：一个集成 N-gram Embedding、从零开始训练的模型。LongCat-Flash-Lite 走完了预训练、mid-training 与监督微调的完整流程，在同规模下展现出很强的竞争力。

6.1Model Information模型信息

Architecture架构

LongCat-Flash-Lite adopts the same architecture as Longcat-Flash (Meituan, 2025), with a total of 14 shortcut layers. It has 68.5 billion total parameters and dynamically activates between 2.9B and 4.5B parameters per token due to the zero-experts. In each shortcut layer, the MoE module consists of 256 FFN experts and 128 zero-experts, and each token selects 12 experts. For embedding module, LongCat-Flash-Lite includes 31.4B N-gram Embedding parameters, accounting for 46% of the total.

LongCat-Flash-Lite 沿用 Longcat-Flash（Meituan, 2025）的架构，共 14 个 shortcut 层。总参数 685 亿，由于 zero-expert 的存在，每个 token 激活的参数在 2.9B 到 4.5B 之间动态变化。每个 shortcut 层里，MoE 模块由 256 个 FFN expert 与 128 个 zero-expert 组成，每个 token 选择 12 个 expert。embedding 模块方面，LongCat-Flash-Lite 含有 31.4B 的 N-gram Embedding 参数，占总参数的 46%。

Training Data训练数据

LongCat-Flash-Lite follows the same data recipe with LongCat-Flash-Chat (Meituan, 2025). It is first pre-trained on 11T tokens with a sequence length of 8k, followed by 1.5T tokens of mid-training during which the sequence length is extended to 128k, and is finally trained on SFT data. To support extended context, we implement YARN (Peng et al., 2023) during the 32k sequence length training stage, enabling LongCat-Flash-Lite to handle sequences up to 256k tokens.

LongCat-Flash-Lite 沿用 LongCat-Flash-Chat（Meituan, 2025）的数据配方。它先在 11T token 上以 8k 序列长度做预训练，接着用 1.5T token 做 mid-training，其间把序列长度扩展到 128k，最后在 SFT 数据上训练。为支撑长上下文，我们在 32k 序列长度阶段的训练中实现了 YARN（Peng et al., 2023），使 LongCat-Flash-Lite 能处理最长 256k token 的序列。

Baseline without N-gram Embedding不带 N-gram Embedding 的基线

We train an MoE baseline with exactly the same parameters as LongCat-Flash-Lite (referred to as LongCat-Flash-Lite-Vanilla) by converting all N-gram Embedding parameters into additional experts. Both models undergo identical training strategy and data recipe.

我们把所有 N-gram Embedding 参数转化为额外的 expert，训练出一个与 LongCat-Flash-Lite 参数量完全一致的 MoE 基线（记为 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Vanilla）。两个模型采用完全相同的训练策略与数据配方。

These findings validate our earlier analysis: when sparsity reaches sufficient levels, strategically scaling total parameters through N-gram Embedding—while maintaining an optimal proportion of embedding parameters—consistently outperforms approaches that merely increase expert numbers.

表 2 给出 LongCat-Flash-Lite 在各基准类别上的完整评测结果，并与 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite（原文脚注：Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Preview 09-2025）以及 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B 做了对比。LongCat-Flash-Lite 在各项核心能力上展现出出色的参数效率与有竞争力的表现。

Agentic Tool Use. LongCat-Flash-Lite excels in agentic tool use tasks, establishing a clear lead over all comparison models. In the τ2-Bench benchmark, it achieves the highest scores across all three sub-scenarios: Telecom (72.8), Retail (73.1), and Airline (58.0). Notably, in the Telecom scenario, its score significantly outperforms Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B. This highlights its superior ability to handle complex dependencies on tools and domain-specific task execution. In VitaBench, it achieves a score of 7.00, outperforming Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct (5.80), and Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (4.50). This leading score underscores LongCat-Flash-Lite’s superior ability to handle complex, real-world task workflows via tool integration in practical business scenarios.

Agent 工具使用。LongCat-Flash-Lite 在 agent 工具调用任务上表现突出，对所有对比模型都建立了明显领先。在 τ2-Bench 基准上，它在三个子场景中都取得了最高分：Telecom（72.8）、Retail（73.1）与 Airline（58.0）。值得注意的是，Telecom 场景下它的分数显著高于 Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite 与 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B。这凸显了它在处理复杂的工具依赖与领域特定任务执行上的优势。在 VitaBench 上它取得 7.00 分，优于 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct（5.80）与 Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite（4.50）。这一领先分数说明 LongCat-Flash-Lite 在真实业务场景中通过工具集成处理复杂任务流程的能力更强。

Agentic Coding. In coding-related tasks, LongCat-Flash-Lite demonstrates remarkable practical problem-solving capabilities. In SWE-Bench, it achieves an accuracy of 54.4, outperforming all baselines—surpassing Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct (37.6), Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (41.3), and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B (32.8) by a significant margin. This indicates its proficiency in solving real-world software engineering issues, including bug fixes and feature implementation. In TerminalBench, which evaluates terminal command execution competence, LongCat-Flash-Lite secures a leading score of 33.75, far exceeding Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct (15.19), Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (20.0) and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B (20.0), reflecting its robust ability to understand and execute terminal-related instructions critical for developer-centric agentic applications. Additionally, in SWE-Bench Multilingual—a benchmark designed to measure cross-language programming generalization across diverse software ecosystems—LongCat-Flash-Lite achieves a strong accuracy of 38.10, outperforming Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct (31.3) and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B (37.2), thus demonstrating its reliable adaptability to multi-language development scenarios. In PRDBench, LongCat-Flash-Lite achieves a score of 39.63, significantly outperforming Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct (15.36). We observe that our model can autonomously write unit tests to verify its development, producing higher-quality code repositories.

Agent 编码。在编码相关任务上，LongCat-Flash-Lite 展现出很强的实际问题求解能力。在 SWE-Bench 上它取得 54.4 的准确率，超过了所有基线——大幅领先 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct（37.6）、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite（41.3）与 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B（32.8）。这表明它擅长解决真实软件工程问题，包括修 bug 与实现新功能。在评测终端命令执行能力的 TerminalBench 上，LongCat-Flash-Lite 取得领先的 33.75 分，远超 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct（15.19）、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite（20.0）与 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B（20.0），反映出它对终端相关指令的理解与执行能力扎实，而这正是面向开发者的 agent 应用所必需的。此外，在用于衡量跨语言编程泛化能力的 SWE-Bench Multilingual 上，LongCat-Flash-Lite 取得 38.10 的较高准确率，优于 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct（31.3）与 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B（37.2），说明它对多语言开发场景有可靠适应性。在 PRDBench 上，LongCat-Flash-Lite 取得 39.63 分，显著优于 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct（15.36）。我们观察到，该模型能自主编写单元测试来验证自己的开发结果，产出的代码仓库质量更高。

General Domains. LongCat-Flash-Lite delivers balanced and competitive performance in general domain knowledge tasks. On MMLU, it scores 85.52, which is comparable to Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (84.68) and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B (79.91), and only slightly lower than Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct (89.28). In Chinese-specific benchmarks (CEval and CMMLU), it achieves 86.55 and 82.48 respectively, performing particularly well against Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B (78.48 and 76.26) and Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (75.16 and 72.06). On GPQA-Diamond, it scores 66.78, maintaining competitiveness within the benchmark’s performance range. For MMLU-Pro, it achieves 78.29, demonstrating solid performance in handling more challenging multi-task language understanding questions.

6.4Fast Inference with Optimized Kernels用优化后的 kernel 实现快速推理

As discussed in Section 4, the extreme activation sparsity of this model necessitates a large effective batch size to fully saturate GPU memory bandwidth. To achieve this, we deploy the model using “Eagle3”  (Li et al., 2025) with a “3-step speculative decoding strategy”. Similarly to Qian et al. (2025) and Meituan (2025), we adopt wide EP (Expert Parallel) and SBO (Single Batch Overlap) to accelerate inference speed. While the above optimizations successfully expands the effective batch size, the model’s lightweight nature shifts the bottleneck towards kernel launch overheads, making it challenging to maintain high GPU occupancy. To address this and minimize end-to-end latency, we implement the following system-level optimizations:

如第 4 节所述，该模型极高的激活稀疏度要求很大的有效 batch size，才能把 GPU 显存带宽吃满。为此，我们采用「Eagle3」（Li et al., 2025）配合「3 步投机解码策略」来部署模型。与 Qian et al. (2025) 和 Meituan (2025) 类似，我们采用 wide EP（Expert Parallel）与 SBO（Single Batch Overlap）来加速推理。上述优化确实成功扩大了有效 batch size，但模型本身的轻量又把瓶颈推到了 kernel 启动开销上，使得维持高 GPU 占用率变得困难。为解决这一问题并把端到端延迟压到最低，我们做了以下系统级优化：

Kernel OptimizationKernel 优化

  • Kernel Fusion: We apply extensive kernel fusion to reduce execution overhead and memory traffic. Specifically, all intra-TP-group communication operations are fused with subsequent fine-grained kernels (e.g., AllReduce + Residual Add + RMSNorm, AllGather + Q-Norm + KV-Norm, and ReduceScatter + RMSNorm + Hidden State Combine). For the quantized model, we integrate every activation quantization step into existing operators, including the aforementioned communication-fusion kernels and the SwiGLU component. Additionally, the processing of router logits (Softmax + TopK + router scaling) and zero-expert selection is consolidated into a single unified kernel.Kernel 融合：我们做了大量 kernel 融合以减少执行开销与显存流量。具体来说，TP 组内所有通信操作都与后续的细粒度 kernel 融合（例如 AllReduce + Residual Add + RMSNorm、AllGather + Q-Norm + KV-Norm、ReduceScatter + RMSNorm + Hidden State Combine）。对量化模型，我们把每一步激活量化都并入既有算子，包括上述通信融合 kernel 与 SwiGLU 组件。此外，router logits 的处理（Softmax + TopK + router scaling）与 zero-expert 选择被合并进一个统一 kernel。
  • Optimized Attention Combine: We employ a splitkv-and-combine strategy during decoding phase. When the number of KV splits is high, the combine operation can incur significant latency, sometimes comparable to the computation itself. By optimizing the combine kernel, we effectively reduce its latency by 50%.Attention Combine 优化：解码阶段我们采用 splitkv-and-combine 策略。当 KV 切分数较多时，combine 操作会产生可观的延迟，有时与计算本身相当。通过优化 combine kernel，我们成功把它的延迟降低了 50%。

PDL (Programmatic Dependent Launch)PDL（Programmatic Dependent Launch）

We utilize PDL  (NVIDIA, 2026) to allow dependent kernels to overlap their execution by triggering early launches. This mechanism not only eliminates the gaps between consecutive kernels but also improves SM utilization.

我们使用 PDL（NVIDIA, 2026），通过提前触发来让相互依赖的 kernel 重叠执行。这一机制不仅消除了相邻 kernel 之间的空隙，还提升了 SM 利用率。

Building upon these optimizations, we achieve the exceptional inference performance illustrated in Figure 8b.

在这些优化的基础上，我们取得了图 8b 所示的出色推理性能。

7Conclusions结论

In this technical report, we presented a comprehensive study on the scalability and efficiency of embedding scaling in LLMs. Through systematic analysis of architectural constraints and comparative scaling laws, we demonstrated that scaling embeddings yields a superior Pareto frontier compared to increasing expert numbers in specific regimes, while our proposed system optimizations, including the N-gram Cache and synchronized kernels, effectively resolve associated I/O bottlenecks. Validating these findings, we introduced LongCat-Flash-Lite, a 68.5B MoE model with over 30B N-gram Embeddingparameters, which not only outperforms parameter-equivalent MoE baselines but also exhibits competitive performance in agentic and coding tasks, thereby establishing a robust and efficient framework for future model scaling.

在本技术报告中，我们系统研究了 LLM 中 embedding 扩展的可扩展性与效率。通过对架构约束的系统分析与扩展律的对比，我们证明在特定区间下，扩展 embedding 相比增加 expert 数量能取得更优的 Pareto 前沿；而我们提出的系统优化（包括 N-gram Cache 与同步 kernel）有效解决了相关的 I/O 瓶颈。为验证这些发现，我们提出 LongCat-Flash-Lite——一个总参数 68.5B、含 30B 以上 N-gram Embedding 参数的 MoE 模型，它不仅优于参数量对齐的 MoE 基线，在 agent 与编码任务上也具备有竞争力的表现，从而为后续模型扩展建立了一套稳健高效的框架。
